name: aelo
description: Ask your assistant about your sales calls and chats in Aelo: transcripts, analyses with quotes and timecodes, deal summaries and team quality — read-only, within your own access

interface.shortDescription: Your sales calls and chats, read-only
interface.longDescription: Ask about your team's calls and chats in plain words: the assistant searches them, reads transcripts and brings analyses with quotes and timecodes, deal summaries and team quality. It only reads, and only what you see in Aelo yourself.
defaultPrompt: Find last week's calls with a quality score below 60
What did the analysis list as improvements for this call?
How did my team's quality change this month?
